about: The Sauce deployment, the same on every chain: one address per contract on every EVM chain, and one id per program on every Solana cluster. An address is where the contract is deployed, not proof that it is there: before relying on one, confirm it has code on the chain (eth_getCode returns more than 0x; on Solana, getAccountInfo returns an executable account).

engine.about: The engine, the interpreter that runs a program. A cook is the Pot's cook(engine, program), sent by the Pot's owner.

kitchen.about: The Kitchen: deployPot(owner, salt) creates a Pot, and executionFee() is the fee every cook pays, in the chain's native coin.

kitchenImplementation.about: The implementation behind the Kitchen, an upgradeable proxy. Call the Kitchen, never this.

router.about: The Router a new Pot starts on, and the one a fixed-Router or Shared Pot minted now is fixed to. The swaps a pool calls back for (Uniswap V3 and V4, Maverick V2, HyperSwap V3) run through the Pot's Router.

quoteRouter.about: A quote service for Uniswap V3 and V4 swaps, called with eth_call, holding no tokens. No Pot's Router.

pot.gateSalt: keccak256(abi.encode(owner, salt)), with true after the salt for a fixed Router or a Shared Pot
pot.about: Where the Kitchen deploys the Pot of an owner under a 32-byte salt, zero unless another is chosen. initCodeHash is what the Kitchen's potInitCodeHash() reports: keccak256 of the Pot's creation code. No Pot's address is CREATE2 under it: address says how a Pot is placed. A Pot keeps its address when a release changes the Router or the engine. A Pot the Kitchen placed by CREATE2 just before it moved to CREATE3 keeps its release's engine, and so does a fixed-Router or Shared Pot minted while the Kitchen handed out an earlier Router (earlierEngines). A fixed-Router or Shared Pot minted on the Router above cooks on the engine above, and so does every dynamic Pot placed by CREATE3, of any age.

earlierEngines.about: Fixed-Router and Shared Pots minted while the Kitchen handed out the Router 0xcc5e707d3c063Faae1e0dAf2C6CBc2Fd076AE759, which only this engine runs
Pots the Kitchen placed by CREATE2 just before it moved to CREATE3, which only this engine runs

engine.about: The engine program new Pots are created under and cooked on. ctx.self() in a program on Solana is the engine running the cook: this one, or an older engine from earlierEngines for a Pot that engine created. key is the 32-byte value a program holds.

earlierEngines.about: An older engine whose programs this SDK's also run on. A Pot it created is cooked on it, and ctx.self() in that program is this engine. A Pot owned by an engine that does not run them is cooked on the engine above. key is the 32-byte value a program holds.

kitchen.about: The Kitchen program: create_pot creates a Pot, and cook runs a program on it. A Pot is the Kitchen's program address for the seeds "pot", the owner and the 32-byte salt. key is the 32-byte value a program holds.
